fields.description: The BoQ whose row this card was made for (the first row carded with this payload).
fields.label: BoQ

fields.description: The committed sheet name, VERBATIM (#152 -- never stripped).
fields.label: Sheet

fields.description: The source Excel row number (= source_row_number).
fields.label: Excel Row

fields.description: The sheet's committed version the payload was read at.
fields.label: Commit Version

fields.description: sha256 of the row's exact extraction._ai_item block as sent (text, notes, headings, Excel row).
fields.label: Payload sha256

fields.description: The card model, from BOQ Upload Review AI Settings.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: ok = a parsed card; malformed = the reply had no usable card for the row (kept, never dropped); failed = the call failed.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The card as the model returned it; for malformed / failed, the error and what came back.
fields.label: Card

fields.description: This row's equal share of its request's input tokens.
fields.label: Tokens in

fields.description: This row's equal share of its request's output tokens.
fields.label: Tokens out

fields.description: This row's equal share of its request's cost.
fields.label: Cost (USD)
